_comment: The library world's books (user, 2026-11-13, GDD 344, 345; core/books.gd, ui/book_view.gd). Ships with the game: each book's title, author, year, its chapters (title and file under web/books/, fetched as it's read) and its title page and first page (readable offline). To add a book: put its chapters in web/books/ID/01.txt, 02.txt, ... (plain text, the chapter's title on the first line), and an entry here; only works whose public-domain status has been checked (GDD 344). The web build copies web/books beside the game and this file to books/catalog.json there (tools/export_web.ps1); the game reads the site's copy when it can, so the shelf can grow by uploading chapters and a newer catalog without a new build. Only the sample book is here so far: a clearly marked placeholder.
